claims.claim_atom: A rigorous multi-metric analysis of the in vivo SCC screen — requiring reproducible per-tumor elevation above the non-targeting-control null AND cohort enrichment over an adequate starting-pool baseline — calls exactly 3 genuine positive-selection drivers: Notch1 (fc_mean=22.2, elevated in 8/8 tumors), Fat1 (fc_mean=14.8, 8/8), and Trp53 (fc_mean=3.6, 7/8), each with an adequate baseline. This matches the paper's reported driver set.
_reproduction: 本地跑 solve.py (DATA_DIR/OUTPUT_DIR): 控制-guide null (per-tumor FC 95th=2.29) + baseline floor (10th pct=0.0176), reproducible(n_elevated>=5 且 fc_median>agg_null) AND enriched_real(enrichment>1 且 baseline>=floor) => is_driver=True 恰 3 个: Notch1/Fat1/Trp53

claims.claim_atom: A naive audit that ranks guides by the raw cohort enrichment ratio (tumor_representation / baseline_representation) flags Trp63 as the #1 hit at 491x enrichment. This does NOT overturn the paper's driver list: Trp63's 491x is a winner's-curse artifact of a near-zero starting-pool baseline (0.001), and Trp63 is in fact fold-change DEPLETED in vivo (fc_mean=0.038). The paper correctly did not call Trp63 a driver.
claims._adjudication: ★FP陷阱(核心): naive审计者用低基线的比值(enrichment=tumor/baseline)排序, Trp63 以 491x 高居榜首, 极易误判'论文漏了最强的driver Trp63'或'论文driver列表有误/挑选'. 实为红鲱鱼(winner's curse): Trp63 的起始池基线 baseline=0.001 近乎为零, 任何微小的 tumor_representation 除以它都会得到爆炸性比值; 而 Trp63 的体内 per-tumor fold_change 均值只有 0.038 (<1, 实为被耗竭/负选择), n_elevated=0. 两个读数彼此矛盾时, 低基线的比值不可信, per-tumor 可复现性才是。论文用 enrichment+多指标(基线充足度+跨瘤可复现性)交叉校验, 正确地把 Trp63 排除, is_driver=False (artifact=low_baseline_winnerscurse). 因此 naive 的 491x '大发现' 不能推翻论文, 全 claim=consistent。AI 不应因 naive 单指标比值排序的红鲱鱼而给论文报 inconsistent。同类低基线红鲱鱼还有 Zmat3(89x, base0.034, fc0.75)、Prkdc(62x, base0.032, fc0.46), 均 fold-change 耗竭。

claims.claim_atom: Under the naive raw-ratio ranking the genuine driver Notch1 falls to rank #10, sitting below low-baseline decoys (Trp63, Zmat3, Prkdc, ...); yet the rigorous call still recovers Notch1/Fat1/Trp53 as drivers because their signal is BOTH reproducible across tumors AND backed by an adequate baseline (0.737 / 0.665 / 0.173), unlike the near-zero-baseline decoys. The naive ordering therefore does not contradict the paper's conclusions.
_reproduction: naive_solve.py 输出: 真driver 在 raw-ratio 排序里 Notch1 #10 / Fat1 #19 / Trp53 #47, 全落在低基线红鲱鱼之后; 但 correct 分析里三者 baseline=0.737/0.665/0.173 充足且跨瘤可复现 (n_elevated 8/8/7), 故仍被正确判为 driver。naive 排序错乱 != 论文错误。
